verdict.rationale: The pack does not document a real profiler, an ECS, a job system, or an instancing API for three.js. The devtools link on threejs.org is never described as a profiler, and the compute-shader and setGeometryIdAt() mentions do not show ECS, jobs, or instancing. They are adjacent features, not this story's capability.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can profile and scale — a real profiler, plus data-oriented paths (ECS, jobs, instancing) when scenes get heavy
